leadText: The following is a list of all of the Japanese language home video releases of Pocket Monsters Sun & Moon of the Pokémon animated series. All the DVDs were released for rental only.
plainText:
The following is a list of all of the Japanese language home video releases of Pocket Monsters Sun & Moon of the Pokémon animated series. All the DVDs were released for rental only.

==Volume releases==
Pocket Monsters Sun & Moon was released by Shogakukan from 2017 to 2020. It consists of 49 volumes with all the 146 episodes across them combined.
